# shoal_namespace (Resource)

A namespace inside the tenant. Workflows, agents, connections, secrets and runs live in namespaces, and people get access through role bindings on them. Maps to `/v1/namespaces/{name}`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "shoal_namespace" "payments" {
  name         = "payments"
  display_name = "Payments"
  description  = "Workflows owned by the payments team"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Namespace name. Changing it recreates the namespace.

### Optional

- `description` (String) What the namespace is for.
- `display_name` (String) Name shown in the UI. Defaults to `name`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Same as `name`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import shoal_namespace.payments payments
```
